query: I was walking my golden retriever puppy this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a neighbor's flower bed, I spent 20 minutes apologizing and helping them replant the tulips that got trampled. Then on my way to the coffee shop I ran into my old high school lab partner, we ended up chatting for ages about the science fair project we messed up back in 10th grade, I can't believe they now work at the bakery down the street from my apartment. I even grabbed a blueberry scone from them on my way out, it was still warm and so buttery I had crumbs all over my jacket pocket. Now that I'm finally sitting down to check my phone, I can't get any mobile data to work at all. I have airplane mode turned on right now, my network preference is set incorrectly, I have a glitchy VPN running, data saver mode is enabled, I already used up all my monthly data allowance, I'm traveling abroad right now and I haven't turned on roaming either, can you help me figure out how to fix this?
